free_text_notes.physician_note: 62-year-old woman with hypertension, CKD stage 3, admitted 5/25 with acute on chronic HFrEF exacerbation with volume overload. Net negative 5.6 L this admission; dyspnea back to baseline. 5/28 07:45: Creatinine rose from 1.4 to 2.1 after diuresis; holding diuretics and rechecking. A slight elevation in liver enzymes was noted on day 1. The test was repeated on day 3 and the result returned to normal. No action is needed.
free_text_notes.nursing_note: Up in chair for meals. Pain controlled. 5/27 15:00: Furosemide changed from 20 mg daily to 40 mg daily this morning. Reviewed with patient and sister at 15:00; teach-back correct. A standard social work screening was completed on admission. The patient did not meet the criteria for a social work referral and no further input was needed.
